rationale: Evaluate the pretrained two-stage PianoMime policy over the first 120 steps (6 seconds), then attach both Shadow hands to a fixed-base Galaxea R1 Pro. Baseline micro F1=0.785, precision=0.766, recall=0.805 does not establish a successful complete performance. During preparation, query G0.5 once with fresh head/wrist images and arm states for bounded arm postures. Its seven arm joints and one gripper scalar per side are not finger commands; PianoMime controls the fingers. Use a conservative lower-priority posture weight of 0.03 alongside palm tracking costs position=100 and orientation=10. Reject preparation if either palm has position error >0.003 m or rotation error >0.03 rad. Do not refresh G0.5 during playing. Its role is limited to proposing preparation postures; this plan makes no claim of improved musical performance.
